notes: Each prompt is a request a formcut user would make with the MCP server connected. Expected behaviours are observable in the tool calls made and the reply.

evals.name: assemble-and-render
evals.prompt: I have /Users/sam/footage/intro.mp4, /Users/sam/footage/interview.mov and /Users/sam/footage/logo.png. Make a 1080p project called Sam interview with the intro, then the interview, then the logo for 3 seconds at the end, and render it as a high quality mp4. Tell me where the file is.
expected_behavior: Calls formcut_status before any other formcut tool
Imports each file with formcut_import_media and uses the media ids those calls return
Creates the project, then adds the three clips end to end, each formcut_add_clip carrying the revision returned by the previous call, with duration 3 for the logo
Calls formcut_render with file_format mp4 and quality high, polls formcut_render_status until done, and reports the output path it returned

evals.name: stale-revision-recovery
evals.prompt: Split the second clip of my project Launch teaser at 4 seconds. I also have the formcut window open and have been moving things around.
expected_behavior: Reads the project with formcut_get_project to get the clip id and the current revision before editing
Uses formcut_edit with a clip.split command, checking the operation name against formcut_capabilities
When the edit is refused for a stale revision, re-reads the project and retries against its current state, instead of guessing a revision or retrying the same call

evals.name: engine-not-running
evals.prompt: Use formcut to render my project Weekly recap as webm.
expected_behavior: When the reply says the engine is not answering, stops the workflow and tells the user to open the formcut app (or start ./formcut in a checkout) or set FORMCUT_ENGINE, rather than calling the render tools
Does not claim a render was started

evals.name: adjacent-task-no-overreach
evals.prompt: What export formats does formcut support, and does it need an account?
expected_behavior: Answers from what formcut is (MP4 or WebM, local first with no account) without importing media, creating a project or starting a render
Does not walk the user through installing the MCP server they did not ask about

evals.name: make-a-look-package
evals.prompt: Make me a warm faded film look called Sunday Film that I can reuse on my clips, and show me what it looks like.
expected_behavior: Calls formcut_package_guide before writing the manifest, and uses only effect ids, parameters and grade settings it lists, within their ranges
Builds a video stack: a grade step for the warmth and fade, then one to three finishing effects with amounts below 1
Adds it with formcut_add_package, then calls formcut_preview_package and describes the result
To change it, adds again with the same id rather than a new one

evals.name: package-no-invented-settings
evals.prompt: Add a package that gives a strong glow with radius 50 and a warmth of 80.
expected_behavior: Looks up glow's parameters and the temperature range in formcut_package_guide instead of inventing a radius or warmth key
Maps the request onto real settings (glow's radius within its range, the grade's temperature within -1 to 1) and says what it chose
If the engine refuses the package, fixes exactly the setting the reason names
